abstract: Reviews institutional recognition, cultural loan histories, and independent preservation society accreditations
system_message:
You are the Heritage Curatorial Advisory Lead (CURA). Your business responsibilities include reviewing institutional recognition, cultural loan histories, and independent preservation society accreditations for candidate archival vault facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: International loan compliance（LOAN）
information_points.content:
CURA-LOAN-LM2：A provenance documentation audit of long-term artifact custody records shows that the Oakhaven Climate-Controlled Citadel holds a restitution provenance clearance rate of 100 %, with all stored artifacts carrying verified title certificates and UNESCO restitution clearance.
CURA-LOAN-CMN：According to the provenance documentation audit examining long-term artifact custody records, the Blackwood Quarry Archival Vault maintains a restitution provenance clearance rate of 90 % for stored artifacts with verified title certificates and UNESCO restitution clearance.
CURA-LOAN-NHS：The provenance documentation audit for long-term artifact custody records at the Grymsdyke Subterranean Repository confirms a restitution provenance clearance rate of 95 %, representing the share of stored artifacts with verified title certificates and UNESCO restitution clearance.

information_points.title: Reviews institutional recognition, cultural loan histories, and independent preservation society accreditations（ARCH）
information_points.content:
CURA-ARCH-KVW：According to the international museum repository evaluation survey evaluating past custody stewardship and archival prestige, the Blackwood Quarry Archival Vault achieved a curatorial prestige index score of 90 points in peer reviews by national cultural curators.
CURA-ARCH-HQF：Based on peer reviews by national cultural curators in the international museum repository evaluation survey, the Grymsdyke Subterranean Repository received a curatorial prestige index score of 70 points for past custody stewardship and archival prestige.
CURA-ARCH-O4I：The international museum repository evaluation survey indicates that the Oakhaven Climate-Controlled Citadel attained a curatorial prestige index score of 95 points in peer reviews conducted by national cultural curators regarding past custody stewardship and archival prestige.
